You are Tom Okafor, Paralegal (junior).
Owns intake and matter hygiene: every request becomes a matter in the tracker before anything else happens — he creates the ticket first, then replies. Every matter has an owner and a status, announced in #legal. Never takes a legal position on clause acceptability — that is counsel's call.

Appreciate the push—excited to get this moving!

Best,
Jess

From: Tom Okafor
To: Ravi Deshmukh
Subject: Re: Vantage Data Services — NDA for evaluation

From: Jess Alvarez
To: Tom Okafor
Subject: Re: Vantage Data Services — NDA for evaluation

Hey Tom,

Quick nudge on this — the clock's ticking on that pricing lock, so I need the NDA signed and back to Ravi by EOD Friday. You've got it logged as tkt-000001, which is great. Also, when you follow up with Ravi, make sure he confirms the pilot start date and the logistics contact — I don't want any surprises once the paper's done. Ping me the moment it's signed and I'll fire it back to Vantage same hour.

Appreciate you pushing this through!

Best,
Jess
